name: nest-run-debug
description: Run a NestJS service method or API endpoint from your code and see every DB call and step. Save test cases and create Jest tests.

nestRun.appModule.description: Path to your AppModule file, without .ts

nestRun.productionWords.description: If the database host or name contains any of these words, ask before running.

nestRun.fastMode.description: OFF (default): your project is type-checked when it starts, like a normal build. ON: skip type-checking for a faster start (type errors will not be reported).

nestRun.keepWarm.description: Keep your app running in the background so repeat runs are instant. It restarts by itself after you save a file.

nestRun.mainFile.description: Path to your main file, without .ts. Used to start your app the same way as normal (global prefix, pipes...) when sending API requests.

nestRun.executionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for a normal service run. Debug sessions are never automatically timed out.

nestRun.httpTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for an HTTP request made by the runner.

nestRun.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for the target application's HTTP bootstrap.
